name: marcadores
title: Marcadores
description: Search browser bookmarks with full Windows support for Vivaldi and Vivaldi Snapshot, opening each bookmark in a new window of the right profile.
author: luan_andrade

preferences.label: Show Bookmark Domain
preferences.name: showDomain
preferences.description: When enabled, the domain of the bookmark will be displayed as a subtitle.

preferences.label: Open Bookmark's Browser
preferences.name: openBookmarkBrowser
preferences.description: When enabled, the extension will open the browser from which the bookmark originated, instead of your default browser.

preferences.label: Open in New Window
preferences.name: openInNewWindow
preferences.description: When enabled, bookmarks open in a new browser window instead of a new tab in the last focused one. The other behaviour stays available as a secondary action.
